model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the relationship between an unspecified variable on the x-axis and informativeness on the y-axis for two methods, 0-CoT and CoRe. The x-axis is labeled with values ranging from 0 to 4, with a linear scale and no units specified, and tick labels are spaced at intervals of 1. The y-axis, labeled "Informativeness", has a linear scale with values from 0.910 to 0.960, and tick labels are spaced at intervals of 0.010. The 0-CoT line, represented by a blue dashed line with circular markers, starts at approximately 0.960 and decreases to around 0.914, showing a steady decline across the x-axis. The CoRe line, represented by an orange solid line with triangular markers, starts at approximately 0.959 and decreases to around 0.918, also showing a steady decline across the x-axis.
